body:
I was bored one day during spring break, and decided to experiment with dosages of Flexeril.  I took four, and became drowsy within 30 minutes, I fell asleep, and from that point on, I'm not sure. Earlier that day I had been with 2 friends, and they had dropped me back off at my house, but every now and then, I'd sit up (or was I still laying down) and they were sitting on the edge of my bed, discussing whether or not I was awake and  if I could hear them. This wasn't an unpleasant experience, just the first of it's kind.
